finding: We tested whether equal memory budgets change which past sources can be retained. At the final 32-observation checkpoint, midpoint priority retains five fewer sources on average than recency under each shared budget, and predicts less accurately when copying has probability one half. Independent reconstruction, all 1,120 paired strata and both complete replays verify this supplied-law constructed-method result. Practical importance, learned provenance, historical process correspondence and human intent remain unestablished.
